rawContent: @KaitlinCurtice @beccabluesky73 It continues because to fully comprehend the ongoing need for the #BlackLivesMatter movement I need to see and work towards dismantling the ways that our schools work for different families, and how they work against certain cultures, framing “respect” in anti-black ways.

@absurdistwords Listening to @NPRCodeSwitch helped me learn my own people (I’m Jewish on my dad’s side) had a similar journey to “becoming white”. Anti-blackness as a unifying tactic? Horrible. #BlackLivesMatter
